scope: Proposition 6.2 (Deterministic covariance and cavity correction) of the manuscript “The free energy of the Ising random perceptron” (preprints/The-free-energy-of-the-Ising-random-perceptron-September-24-2026/The-free-energy-of-the-Ising-random-perceptron-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 222 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d848ece0b215a2b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Start with any deter- ministic good parameter sequence, on any subsequence of dimensions. Pass to a further subsequence on which the omitted overlap array converges and the full system’s joint sampled arrays (Rlm, BN (xl, xm), CN (xl)) converge. Let µ be the omitted limit’s two-replica overlap law. The full limiting overlap array has the same law as the omitted one. There are deter- ministic constants ad, c and a deterministic nondecreasing function a, defined on a µ-full ordered subset of [0, 1], such that almost surely Blm = a(Rlm) (l ̸= m), Bll = ad, Cl = c, 0 ≤ a ≤ ad ≤ α∥f′ ∥2 ∞. (6.13) Moreover, c + ad = Z r a(r) µ(dr). (6.14)
